pinned_fsa_source_estimate.accounting_scope: Pinned FSA forward source allocations for one sequence. Partial buffers have head_tile=1 and are reused serially across query heads. Output, LSE, Q/K/V, allocator fragmentation, and temporary PyTorch indexing/cummax workspace are excluded.

buffers.shuttle_plan_scope: One FP32 (max, denominator, weighted-value) state per block edge, query token, and query head

candidate.executable_seam: RelationPlan -> repeated token-level topk_idx -> pinned FSA public selected-attention call

semantic_mismatches.adapter_effect: Each generic edge is repeated across its query-block tokens and all KV heads.
semantic_mismatches.mismatch: Shuttle has one edge per query-block/selected-block pair; FSA accepts one selected-block list per query token and KV head.

semantic_mismatches.adapter_effect: The timed FSA call reconstructs a private block-to-token relation, so it is a KV-major expert oracle rather than an execution of Shuttle's physical schedule.
semantic_mismatches.mismatch: FSA cannot consume RelationPlan grouped_route_indices, destination offsets, or inverse mapping.

semantic_mismatches.adapter_effect: The identical relation is duplicated across KV heads.
semantic_mismatches.mismatch: FSA permits a different selected relation per KV head; the Shuttle experiment is block-shared.

semantic_mismatches.adapter_effect: The adapter rejects non-increasing selected-slot order instead of silently changing Shuttle's source-ordered floating-point merge contract.
semantic_mismatches.mismatch: Pinned FSA's online maxima are accumulated in ascending physical KV-block order and its input generator sorts top-k indices.

semantic_mismatches.adapter_effect: This benchmark is restricted to causal self-attention with equal Q and KV lengths.
semantic_mismatches.mismatch: The public FSA entry point uses one shared Q/K/V cumulative-length vector and always runs its causal forward path.

semantic_mismatches.adapter_effect: Shuttle relation planning and adapter expansion are timed separately; FSA's internal planning, allocations, compute, and merge remain combined in the kernel sample.
semantic_mismatches.mismatch: The public FSA call does not expose separate inverse-plan, QK/PV, partial-state, or reduction timings.
